summary: Iteration 76 - Maintenance Module Testing Complete. All 24 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend UI components verified working including Kanban board, Table view, Create Issue dialog, Issue Detail drawer, Preventive tab, and Analytics tab.

issues: Minor: Missing aria-describedby for DialogContent (accessibility warning in console)

create_issue_endpoint.description: POST /api/maintenance/issues - creates issue with auto-department assignment and SLA deadline
tests: Creates issue with all required fields
Auto-assigns department based on category (plumbing->maintenance, cleaning->housekeeping, safety->management, it_network->management)
Calculates SLA deadline based on priority (critical=2h, high=8h, medium=24h, low=72h)
Sets initial status to 'open' and sla_breached to false
Returns list of issues for property
Filters by status work correctly
Filters by priority work correctly
Filters by category work correctly
'all' property_id returns issues across all properties

update_issue_endpoint.description: PUT /api/maintenance/issues/{issue_id} - updates issue with status transitions
tests: Updates issue fields
Tracks acknowledged_at when status changes to 'acknowledged'
Tracks started_at when status changes to 'in_progress'
Tracks resolved_at when status changes to 'resolved'
Tracks closed_at when status changes to 'closed'
Uploads photo and returns URL
Photo URL starts with /api/uploads/maintenance/
Photo is attached to issue's photos array
Returns 404 for non-existent issue
Adds comment with text, author, created_at, and id
Comments are stored in issue's comments array
Returns 404 for non-existent issue
Updates estimated_cost, actual_cost, cost_notes, and materials
Cost data persists and can be retrieved
Returns total, open, in_progress, resolved, overdue counts
Returns by_category breakdown
Returns by_priority breakdown
Returns costs with total_estimated and total_actual
'all' property_id returns stats across all properties

sla_check_endpoint.description: POST /api/maintenance/check-sla/{property_id} - checks and marks SLA breaches
tests: Returns checked count and newly_breached count
Marks issues as sla_breached when deadline passed
POST creates recurring schedule with frequency, is_active, next_due
GET lists recurring schedules for property
PUT updates recurring schedule
DELETE removes recurring schedule

generate_recurring_endpoint.description: POST /api/maintenance/recurring/generate/{property_id} - generates issues from due schedules
tests: Returns generated count and schedules_checked count
Creates issues from due schedules with [Scheduled] prefix
Updates next_due date after generation

critical_code_review_comments: Maintenance module well-implemented with comprehensive CRUD operations
Auto-assignment rules correctly map categories to departments
SLA calculation correctly applies different targets based on priority
Status transitions properly track timestamps (acknowledged_at, started_at, resolved_at, closed_at)
Photo upload correctly stores files and attaches URLs to issues
Comments/Activity log properly stores author and timestamp
Cost tracking includes estimated, actual, notes, and materials array
Recurring maintenance correctly calculates next_due based on frequency
Stats endpoint provides comprehensive breakdowns by category, priority, and costs
Frontend Kanban board provides intuitive drag-free status management via buttons
All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing
seed_data_creation: Test data created and cleaned up during tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 76 tested the new Maintenance module with 8 features: Photo/Video Attachments, Auto-Assignment & Notifications, SLA Tracking & Response Times, Cost Tracking, Kanban Board View, Priority Levels (Critical/High/Medium/Low), Comments/Activity Log, and Recurring/Preventive Maintenance. All backend endpoints working correctly. Frontend panel has 3 tabs (Issues, Preventive, Analytics), Kanban/Table view toggle, Create Issue dialog, and Issue Detail drawer with status actions, photos, cost tracking, and comments. SLA targets: critical=2h, high=8h, medium=24h, low=72h. Auto-assignment maps categories to departments (plumbing/electrical/hvac/furniture/appliance/structural/pest_control/general->maintenance, cleaning->housekeeping, safety/it_network->management).

mocked_apis.note: All maintenance APIs are fully functional with MongoDB persistence
